business_problem: ThredUp needed a better way to support marketplace personalization, machine learning, and analyst self-service for fashion resale because marketplace scale and fragmented tooling kept onboarding slow and prevented analysts and data scientists from moving quickly on high-value models.
solution_summary: ThredUp uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support marketplace personalization, machine learning, and analyst self-service for fashion resale. The implementation replaced a legacy state where marketplace scale and fragmented tooling kept onboarding slow and prevented analysts and data scientists from moving quickly on high-value models. Marketplace inventory data and buyer and seller behavior move through Lakeflow Jobs and Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Model Serving and Genie operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver personalization models and analyst and scientist workspaces.
business_outcome: ThredUp improved marketplace personalization, machine learning, and analyst self-service for fashion resale with measurable results including 71% to identify, train and stage ml models instead of weeks, Decrease in onboarding time for new analysts and data scientists (2 weeks to 4 days), and For new users to build MVPs, as opposed to 2 months, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
